notes.title: Patch - 0.3.416
notes.notes:
[h1]Optimization & Improvements[/h1]

Hey everyone!

We have been working hard under the hood to make the game faster, smoother and ready for the future.
We rewritten some parts of the game for better adaptation to the upcoming gameplay changes. 

[h2]PERFORMANCE UPDATE[/h2]

[h3]Upgraded to Unity 6[/h3]
We moved the game to Unity 6 for better performance, stability and access to the latest features.

[h3]GPU Occlusion Culling[/h3]
Enabling this feature improved FPS for players with older gpus.

[h3]GPU Skinning[/h3]
Character animations are now handled by the GPU reducing CPU load and making things run smoother even with lots of characters on screen.

[h3]DirectX 12 Support[/h3]
Undead City now using DirectX 12 for improved multithreaded rendering. This helps the game to take advantage of modern CPUs and GPUs by splitting up graphics tasks.

These changes should give you a noticeable performance boost and prepare the game for future content and updates. 

[h2]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h2]

[h3]Limb Dismemberment[/h3]
Blow off limbs. Zombies now react more dynamically to where you hit them.

[h3]Wound Marks on Hit[/h3]
Weapons now leave visible damage on zombies where you hit them.

[h3]Facial Animations[/h3]
Zombies now has new facial animations.

notes.title: Upgrading to Unity 6
notes.notes:
📣 Announcement: Upgrading to Unity 6! 📣

Hello Survivors!

We are excited to announce that Undead City is getting a significant upgrade. We are currently in the process of upgrading the game engine to Unity 6. This update will allow us to enhance performance, bring new features and improve visuals making Undead City even more immersive.

What does this mean for you?
As we transition to the new Unity version you may experience updates that improve gameplay, graphics, and stability. We are committed to making this process as smooth as possible and ensuring that the game continues to provide an enjoyable experience during early access.

We will keep you posted on our progress and will share more details on the specific improvements as they roll out. Thank you for being part of our community and stay tuned for more exciting updates.

Happy surviving.
The Undead City Team

notes.title: Undead City - Co-op
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The moment you've been waiting for has arrived – Co-op Mode is now LIVE! 🎉 Bring your friends, strategize, and dive into the action together. Whether you're exploring new areas, taking on powerful enemies, or just goofing off, it's time to experience Undead City in a whole new way!

What's New in Co-op Mode:

👫 2-4 player co-op: Invite your friends to join you in both the main campaign and side quests!
🛠️ New co-op missions: Unique challenges that require teamwork and clever strategies.
Grab your gear, gather your friends, and jump into the fun! As always, we’d love to hear your feedback. Join the discussion in the community forums and let us know what you think.

Happy gaming, and see you in co-op! 🕹️

notes.title: Removing the Demo
notes.notes:
Hello, Undead City community!

We hope you enjoyed the demo. We are incredibly grateful for all the feedback and support you’ve given us so far.

Demo does not reflect the current state of the game and we are releasing a new patch in couple weeks.
So we want to inform you that we will be taking down the demo from the store page. We need to concentrate our resources on the development Undead City. The insights and suggestions we’ve gathered from the demo have been invaluable, and we’re eager to implement them into the final product.

P.S We plan to to release a new demo after 1.0 launch.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

Best regards,
RedGritGames

notes.title: Changelong - 0.1.358

[list]
[*]Improvement : The star icon on the compass is visible all time so players can navigate easier.
[*]Improvement : Loading times improvements for old hard drives.
[*]Critical Bug Fix : Leaving the game mid mission and starting another one causes the mission to bug out.
[*]Bug Fix : Disable virtual pointer on the main menu if a gamepad is not present.
[*]Bug Fix : Pressing H does not heal the player.
[*]Bug Fix : Invisible Zombies.
[*]Feature : Loot overhaul. Entire loot system has changed. Implemented Shuffle Bag algorithm more you loot more you get high tier items.
[*]Feature : Lockpicking, some vehicles have locked boxes you need a unlock them by lockpicking and get top tier loot (MP5, AKM, F1 etc).
[*]Feature :Loot pool is expanded now you can loot clips, ammo boxes, throwables and weapons.
[*]Feature : Added new weapons, MP5, Molotov, Grenade, F1, Flare gun.
[*]Feature : Interactive looting you can loot by interacting objects directly
[*]Feature : New Mission takes place in the dangerous night of undead city.
[*]Feature :Adding hit markers.
[*]Improvement: Taking damage has screen space blood fx. 
[/list]
